topic_naming: <token>-<event-name>, 6 partitions, key = orderRef (holdRef only for holds that never reached an order)

services.name: orders
services.runtime: Knative Service (request-driven, min-scale 0, max-scale 6) + KEDA-scaled outbox relay Deployment (postgresql scaler on unpublished outbox rows)
api: POST /api/purchase — legacy purchase body {performanceId,email,quantity,section?,promoCode?,delivery?,cardLast4?,clientRef?}; calls seats POST /api/holds, prices the hold, writes order (PENDING_PAYMENT) + items + fees + outbox row in one transaction; 202 {orderRef,status:PENDING_PAYMENT,totalCents,tickets:0,paymentOutcome:PENDING}; 409 SOLD_OUT / 404 NOT_FOUND / 400 BAD_QUANTITY|BAD_REQUEST pass through from seats; same clientRef replays the same order
POST /api/orders — place from an existing hold {holdRef,email,promoCode?,delivery?,cardLast4?,clientRef?}; 410 HOLD_EXPIRED if seats says the hold is not active; otherwise as /api/purchase

GET /api/orders/{ref} — order (order_ref,status,subtotal_cents,fees_cents,total_cents,channel,email,event_title,starts_at,venue_name,created_at) + items[] (section,row_label,seat_number,zone,price_cents,ticket_code) + fees[] + paymentOutcome; 404 NOT_FOUND
POST /events/payment-failed — inbox: sets status PAYMENT_FAILED | PAYMENT_TIMEOUT | CANCELLED (outcome HOLD_EXPIRED) by orderRef; idempotent
POST /events/order-confirmed — inbox: sets status CONFIRMED and stamps ticket_code on order_items by orderRef; idempotent
POST /events/hold-expired — inbox: PENDING_PAYMENT orders on that hold become CANCELLED; idempotent
GET /stats — {ordersTotal, ordersByStatus{...}, outboxUnpublished, promoUses}
GET /actuator/health — readiness/liveness
GET /actuator/prometheus — Micrometer; includes orders_outbox_unpublished gauge

services.name: seats
services.runtime: Knative Service (request-driven, min-scale 0, max-scale 6); a CronJob (every minute) calls POST /api/holds/sweep
api: POST /api/holds — {performanceId,quantity,section?,customerEmail?}; best-available hold with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, marks rows HELD for HOLD_MINUTES; 201 {holdRef,performanceId,expiresAt,seats[{seatInventoryId,section,rowLabel,seatNumber,priceZoneId,zoneCode,zoneName}],zoneTally[{priceZoneId,notAvailable,total}]} (tally taken after the hold, inside the same transaction); 404 NOT_FOUND (performance), 400 BAD_QUANTITY (quantity < 1 or > max_per_order), 409 SOLD_OUT
GET /api/holds/{holdRef} — {holdRef,status,active,expiresAt,seats[]}; active = status ACTIVE and expires_at > now; 404
GET /api/performances/{id}/availability — {available,held,sold} (legacy path, unchanged shape)

POST /api/holds/sweep (alias POST /api/admin/expire-holds) — releases ACTIVE holds with expires_at < now (<=500 per call): seats back to AVAILABLE, hold EXPIRED, publishes hold-expired and delivers it to orders; {released:n}
POST /events/payment-failed — inbox: hold RELEASED, its HELD seats back to AVAILABLE, order_ref cleared; idempotent
POST /events/order-confirmed — inbox: hold CONVERTED, its seats SOLD with order_ref stamped; idempotent
GET /stats — {seatsAvailable, seatsHeld, seatsSold, holdsByStatus{ACTIVE,CONVERTED,EXPIRED,RELEASED}}
GET /actuator/health — readiness/liveness
GET /actuator/prometheus — Micrometer

services.name: payments
services.runtime: Kafka consumer Deployment (group <token>-payments, manual offset commit after the DB transaction), KEDA ScaledObject kafka trigger min 0 / max 6, cooldown <= 60s
api: GET /api/payments/{orderRef} — {orderRef,status,amountCents,gatewayRef,cardLast4,attempts[{attemptNo,outcome,latencyMs}]}; 404
GET /stats — {paymentsCaptured, capturedCents, paymentsDeclined, paymentsTimeout, paymentsExpired, attempts, duplicatesSuppressed}
GET /actuator/health — readiness/liveness
GET /actuator/prometheus — Micrometer; includes gateway latency histogram and duplicates_suppressed counter

services.name: confirmations
api: POST /events/payment-captured — inbox: issues one ticket per seat (ticket_code TK-…, barcode), writes the confirmation row (recipient, subject 'Your tickets for <title>', body as the monolith), publishes order-confirmed and delivers it to orders and seats; idempotent on orderRef (confirmations.order_ref UNIQUE): a replay returns the existing tickets and re-delivers
GET /api/confirmations/{orderRef} — {orderRef,ticketCount,tickets[{ticketCode,seatInventoryId,barcode,issuedAt}],confirmation{recipient,subject,body,sentAt}}; 404
GET /stats — {ticketsIssued, confirmationsQueued, confirmationsSent}
GET /actuator/health — readiness/liveness
GET /actuator/prometheus — Micrometer

events.name: order-placed
events.delivery: Kafka only — payments is a real consumer (KEDA lag trigger)

events.name: payment-captured
events.delivery: Kafka record, then payments POSTs the same payload to confirmations /events/payment-captured before committing its offset

events.name: payment-failed
events.delivery: Kafka record, then payments POSTs the same payload to orders and seats /events/payment-failed before committing its offset

events.name: order-confirmed
events.delivery: Kafka record, then confirmations POSTs the same payload to orders and seats /events/order-confirmed within the inbox request

events.name: hold-expired
events.key: orderRef when a PENDING_PAYMENT order is attached, else holdRef
events.delivery: Kafka record, then seats POSTs the same payload to orders /events/hold-expired within the sweep request
